english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a cooking pot.
This is the all-purpose spoken term when the exact type of cooking vessel is not important or is clear from context.

examples.english: This pot is very handy for making soup.
examples.traditional: 呢個煲用嚟煲湯好方便。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 bou1 jung6 lei4 bou1 tong1 hou2 fong1 bin6

examples.english: This saucepan is the most convenient for cooking noodles.
examples.traditional: 呢個煲用嚟煮麵最方便。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 bou1 jung6 lai4 zyu2 min6 zeoi3 fong1 bin6
